d:
Shayad hi koee din bitta hai, jab midiya men voshingtan, D.C. ki tasviren na dikhen. amerika ki rajdhani desh ki rajniti ka kendr hai aur iski mashhur aitihasik imarten atit ki jhalak dikhati hain.
Voshingtan ke smarak duniyabhar men mashhur hain. vait haus se kaipital aur linkan memoriyal tak, ye amerika ka itihas batate hain. linkan memoriyal men hi martin luthar king juniyar ne apna mashhur ‘aaee haiv a drim’ bhashan diya tha.
